# Animated sorting example: the Transition Duration field throws

## Context

Found during team:engine release testing for 13.3. In `examples/grid/animatedRowSorting`, every change to the *Transition Duration* field throws:

```
TypeError: Cannot set properties of null (setting 'transitionDuration')
```

Typing `1000` throws five times, and the duration stays `500ms` in both bodies. Observed 2026-10-20 ~10:22Z in headless branded Chrome against the dev server serving `origin/dev` 4844087a77. In the same run, header sorts and the Firstname filter work and the locked Id rows stay with their center rows.

13.3's notes feature this example ("Animated row sorting works again"), so its own control throwing ships with the cut unless it is fixed first.

## The Problem

`Viewport#onTransitionDurationFieldChange` (`examples/grid/animatedRowSorting/Viewport.mjs:84`) reads `grid.view.getPlugin('grid-animate-rows')`. That stopped working on 2026-04-02, when #9627 made `grid.view` a `Neo.grid.View`. A View owns no plugins. AnimateRows belongs to each `Neo.grid.Body`: `Body#afterSetAnimatedRowSorting` adds it (`src/grid/Body.mjs:391`). So `getPlugin()` returns `null`.

This has been broken since #9627, and 13.2.0 ships the same handler. 13.3 adds a second body to repair: since #19777, the example locks its Id column, and the locked body is a clone of the center body with its own plugin. A fix that reaches only the center body would move the locked rows at the old duration, out of step with their center rows.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.grid.View#bodies` (`src/grid/View.mjs:218`): "The active bodies in visual order (`bodyStart`, `body`, `bodyEnd`)".
- `AnimateRows#afterSetTransitionDuration` (`src/grid/plugin/AnimateRows.mjs`) sets `--neo-duration` on its owner body. `resources/scss/src/grid/plugin/AnimateRows.scss` drives the rows' `transform`, `opacity` and `background-color` transitions from that variable.
- Design authority: the field was added for this purpose in `73a4190925` (#6562, "add a transition duration numberfield"). A field labelled *Transition Duration* that throws and changes nothing contradicts its own handler.

## The Fix

`onTransitionDurationFieldChange` sets the duration on the plugin of every body in `grid.view.bodies`. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/AnimatedRowSorting.spec.mjs` gains a case for the field.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: changing the field logs no error, and every body's `--neo-duration` reads the field's value.
- [ ] AC-2: a sort after the change moves the rows of both bodies, locked and center, with the new duration.
- [ ] AC-3: the new e2e case is red on base (the TypeError, `500ms`) and green at head, and the spec's four existing cases stay green.

## Out of Scope

- A grid-level API for the animation duration. The example is its only runtime consumer, and a grid's `body.pluginAnimateRowsConfig` already sets it at construction.

## Related

- #6858 / #19774 (AnimateRows on the pooled body), #19772 / #19777 (locked bodies clone their center instances), #9627 (`grid.View`), #19712 (13.3 notes).
